title: Mar y Tierra
lyrics:
# Suno v5.5 Prompt: "Mar y Tierra" (Reggaeton & Happy Hardcore Fusion)

Use these parameters in Suno v5.5 to generate an upbeat, high-energy Spanglish promo track for Restaurante Brisas Marinas, blending dembow rhythm with happy hardcore synth leads.

---

### 1. Suno Style Tags (Bypasses Filters)
```text
160 BPM, 4/4 time, happy hardcore, reggaeton dembow beat, energetic electronic pop, bright euphoric synth leads, Spanglish male/female duet, driving dance bassline, uplifting party vibe, 336 Hz tuning
```

---

### 2. Structured Lyrics Prompt

```text
[Intro]
(0:00 - 0:15)
[Fast euphoric happy hardcore synth lead hook, dembow drums kick in]
¡Brisas Marinas!
San Juan del Sur...
Mar y Tierra, baby. Let's go!

[Verse 1 - Male Vocals]
(0:15 - 0:45)
Walking down the malecón, the sun goes down
Naranja sky over the beachfront town
We got a table for two, right by the sea
Ensalada, cold beers, and the ocean breeze
Fresh lobster tail, shrimp in the pan
The best mariscos in all of the land.

[Verse 2 - Female Vocals]
(0:45 - 1:15)
Y para la carne, la brasa está lista
El mejor corte con la mejor vista
Sabor de Nicaragua, feel the dembow beat
Sovereign kitchen where the currents meet
Reserva tu mesa, don't be late tonight
We serve the magic under sunset light.

[Chorus - Duet Harmony]
(1:15 - 1:45)
[Hardcore synths rise to a climax, driving dembow beat drops heavy]
¡Mar y Tierra! El sabor del mar,
Brisas Marinas, no vas a olvidar.
Atardecer naranja, música y acción,
The heartbeat of the malecón!
¡Mar y Tierra! El sabor del mar,
Brisas Marinas, ¡ven a disfrutar!

[Bridge - Instrumental Climax]
(1:45 - 2:15)
[Epic happy hardcore lead solo, reggaeton dembow drum fills, rapid snare rolls]

[Outro]
(2:15 - 2:45)
[Dembow slows down, synths echo out with beach wave sound effects]
Nica Libre in hand...
Right on time.
San Juan del Sur.
Brisas... Marinas.
[Tuning frequency hum, fade to silence]
```
